cases.name: Michelle "Shelly" Bennett
cases.about: A mother, wife, lover of horses, and friend is how Michelle will be remembered by those who loved her. Friends and former co-workers expressed love for their beloved “Shelly.” “I’m in shock. Shelly was such a sweet person. One of the greatest people I’ve ever worked with,” said Rainy Reddick in a Facebook comment. Her character is what leaves those who knew her in shock. Francis added, “She was very upbeat and very, very nice. At the time I was there, she just wanted me to take their little gas issue, which was to get their fireplace going. I was happy to do that.”
cases.narrative: He called 911 and she was discovered slumped over the kitchen table with a large kitchen knife in her back.
